text: קוֹל יִתְּנוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: קְרוּאִים יִמְלוֹכוּ. וְאַחֲרָיו יַהֲלוֹכוּ. קוֹמְמִיּוּת יֵלֵכוּ. וּבְרֹאשָׁם יִמְלֹךְ: רָז הַמִּכְמָן. לְיוֹם זֶה מְזֻמָּן. רָשׁוּם לְמוֹעֵד וּזְמַן. וּבוֹ נוֹקֵם יִמְלֹךְ: רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן. בְּבֹאוֹ מִתֵּימָן. רוּחַ יַסְעִיר כְּתֵימָן. בְּגִלְעָד יִמְלֹךְ: שִׁנְאָן עֲלִיּוֹת. וְסוֹד פְּלִיאוֹת (נ״א פְּלִילִיּוֹת). שִׁיר מְתֻלָּלִיּוֹת. יִפְצְחוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: שְׁאוֹת תַּחְתִּיּוֹת. וְהוֹד אוֹתִיּוֹת. שְׁאוֹן הֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת. יָרִיעוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: תִּכּוֹן כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. שְׁמוֹ לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ. תָּאָרְכוּ כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. בְּמָלְכוֹ יִמְלֹךְ: חזן תּוֹקֵף מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ. וְעַד מְבוֹא שֶׁמֶשׁ. תַּמָּה בָּרָה כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. יְרוֹמֵם וְיִמְלֹךְ:

רַכָּה עֲדִינָה. שָׁקְדָה מֵאַלְמוֹן. כִּי אָרַךְ לָהּ. קֵץ הַמְּלוּכָה: חזן רִיבוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים. שְׂאוּ אֶדֶר מְאוֹרִים. וְשָׁרֵת עַל אָרוֹן. הוֹד הַמְּלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה: שׂוֹא שְׂנָא אֵל. וְהוּא עַל לְשׁוֹנֵנוּ. בַּקֵּשׁ אֱמֶת וָאֵין. וְרָחֲקָה מְלוּכָה: חזן שַׁדַּי הָסֵר אוֹן מִצְּבָאֶיךָ. וְיָרִיעוּ לְךָ. תְּרוּעַת מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ: תַּחֲנוּן גֵּאוּת. תִּתְאוֹרֵר עֹז. לְבַל יִשְׁתָּרֵר. זָר בִּמְלוּכָה:

כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וְנֶאֱמַר לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ: וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כִּי לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה וּמוֹשֵׁל בַּגּוֹיִם: וְנֶאֱמַר יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט: וְנֶאֱמַר שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה: וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגֹאֲלוֹ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי רִאשׁוֹן וַאֲנִי אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדַי אֵין אֱלֹהִים: וְנֶאֱמַר וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה: וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד: וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:

text: חזן תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל. כִּי יִנָּעֵר רָשָׁע. וְשָׂם צֶדֶק לְרַגְלָיו. וְיִצְנוֹף מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט: תָּקוּם גּוֹיִם. תּוֹכִיחַ לְאֻמִּים. תִּשְׁבּוֹר מַטֵּה רָשָׁע. מוֹשֵׁל הַמְּלוּכָה: חזן תַּחֲלִיף אֱלִילִים. תַּשְׂגֵּב לְבַדֶּךָ. הִקָּרֵא נֶצַח. יִחוּד בַּמְּלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד: וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:

who once ruled, will throw off their raiment, they will offer praise and pay homage to the Lord when He will reign. Those called by the Lord shall reign and after Him will they follow, upright will they walk and at their head will He reign. The hidden secret (of the redemption) is prepared for this day, recorded for the time and season on which in retribution He will reign. The Faithful Shepherd, when He comes from Teman, the wind will roar in Teman, in Gilead will He reign. The heavenly Shinanim and the assembly of angels will utter a song of praise in the heights, for He will reign. The depths of the earth, the marvellous heavenly bodies, the roaring mass of creatures, rejoice when He will reign. Established shall be the throne of him who is like the sun (the anointed), his name existed even before the sun, his appearance is as the going out of the sun, in God’s realm will He reign. He who from sunrise to sunset sustains the flawless people that is bright as the sun (Israel), will exalt and reign.

text: The voluptuous one (Babel) sprawled at ease, she did not fear widowhood, for far from her was the end of the kingdom. Struggle, deliverers, take the royal gown from Edom and adorn the Lord with the splendour of the Kingdom. As it was written through Thy prophet: Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s. God hates falsehood, yet it is upon our tongue; He demands truth, but it is not there; and, therefore, distant became the Kingdom. Almighty, remove guilt from Thy hosts that they may cry out to Thee with the Teruah of the Kingdom. As it is written in Thy Torah: And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel. The Lord, his God, is with him, and the royal Teruah is within him. Gird Thyself in loftiness, surround Thyself with strength, so that no stranger may rule over the Kingdom.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever.’ And it was said: ‘And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel, the Lord His God is with him and the royal Teruah within him.’ And it was said: ‘And He became King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel’. And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘For dominion is the Lord’s and He is ruler over nations’. And it was said: ‘The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.’ And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in war. Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel and its redeemer, the Lord of Hosts: I am the first and I am the last and apart from Me there is no God’. And it was said: ‘Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s. And it was said: ‘And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One’. And in Thy Torah it is written saying: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One’.

text: The world will be firm when the wicked is shaken off, the Lord will set justice beneath Him and put on the crown of the Kingdom. As it is written in Thy holy words: The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter. Thou wilt take vengeance on nations, Thou wilt rebuke peoples, Thou wilt break the staff of evil, ruling over the Kingdom. Thou wilt make idols disappear, Thou alone wilt be exalted, Thou wilt be invoked for ever, unique in the Kingdom. As it is written through Thy prophet: The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His name One. And it is written in Thy Torah: Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.
